versions.changelog:
risk-assessment-bundle v1.0.0

- Initial release of the risk-assessment-bundle signal.
- Provides combined analytics: portfolio heat, liquidation pressure, and position exposure in a single call.
- Real-time data computed from APEX Runner's live autonomous trading system (not backtests).
- x402-authenticated GET endpoint; requires only an EVM wallet with USDC on Base mainnet.
- Tiered, pay-per-call pricing with automatic discounts for early and frequent users.
